E0029

Two access markers on one parameter (D-CAP7/D-MEM1)

What

Two access markers on one parameter (D-CAP7/D-MEM1)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0029

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0029: tests/ui/two_capability_markers.stderr.

Error [E0029]: `x` has two access markers
  --> tests/ui/two_capability_markers.jet:3:10
    |
  3 | fn bump(&x: &Int) {
    |          ^
 Why: the write-access marker `&` before the parameter name conflicts with the write-access marker `&` on its type; a parameter can declare only one access marker
 Fix: keep one access marker on the type or receiver and remove the other
